svg.text: Two-meeter atlas v2: the smallest displacement of the first meeter at which a second meeter of the unit corner box exists (green = second-meeter centres at that threshold; pale = widened box)
v1 showed a PRESSED first meeter (touching both walls) admits no second meeter of the unit box at any tilt; dashed = sidebands x=1, y=1; blue = the unit corner box; cyan = Q1.
